paragraphs: I bridge production AI engineering, responsible AI, and software security. At Koch Ag & Energy Solutions, I lead systems from discovery through deployment, with an emphasis on real-world value, reliability, governance, and security.

Beyond my industry work, I build open-source audit tools and fine-tuned models, publish research on explainability, model bias, computer vision, and AI security, and coordinate vulnerability disclosures for widely used Python and AI/ML software.
